thread:
jason: Deploybot finished rollout v2.15.0 -> prod at 2026-01-14T21:10:34Z. Quick streaming probes show chunk latency p95 in us-west jumped ~2x. Prefill/KV look fine. Anyone near the streaming dashboards?

deploy-bot: rollout v2.15.0 completed (rollout_id=rl-0k1) :white_check_mark:

mira: I see it on the streaming dashboard. p50 stable, but chunk p95 went from ~60ms to ~140ms in the last 10m for us-west. Error rate tiny (~0.05%) so not failing requests, just tail.

ken: any change to batching or kernel selection in this release? I remember a hopeful switch to new continuous-batching kernel for streaming. Could be the cause.

jason: yes, we flipped batching_kernel=continuous in the runtime defaults for this release. If that's the culprit we can revert the runtime flag in-region while we investigate. Prefer an in-region flag override to avoid full rollback.

mira: agree. let's do a short flag override (20m) to restore legacy batching in us-west and run extended streaming synths to compare. I'll prepare the synth.

ken: running override now:
```
redwood runtime set --region us-west --flag batching_kernel=legacy --ttl 20m --reason "postdeploy streaming chunk tail"
```

ops-bot: runtime flag override applied by ken at 2026-01-14T21:15:02Z (us-west: batching_kernel=legacy), TTL 20m.

perf-bot: quickcheck (5m window) after override: streaming_chunk_p95(us-west)=68ms (was 142ms pre-override), p99=180ms -> improved. Small sample size.

mira: kicked off expanded streaming synth (long streams + interleaved small requests) to capture realistic fanout. Command: `./ops/stream-smoke --profile long-streams --region us-west --duration 12m`

jason: thanks. ken, capture kernel traces and per-host batch sizes during synth. If legacy stabilizes tail, we either keep the flag or iterate on the continuous kernel.

ken: collecting traces now. Early look: continuous kernel increased mean batch assembly latency on hosts with bursty small requests. One host shows assembly delays ~40ms. Posting trace link: https://internal/trace/stream/311222-a (short).

perf-bot: expanded synth results: v2.15.0 w/legacy-batching sample p95=72ms, continuous-batching sample p95=138ms. Errors stable.

jason: decision: keep runtime override in us-west for 30m to be safe, block global default flip until kernel issue is mitigated. ken to open a kernel investigation ticket and perf PR. mira will update release notes and CS.

ken: applying extended TTL: `redwood runtime set --region us-west --flag batching_kernel=legacy --ttl 30m --reason "postdeploy - mitigate streaming tail while investigate kernel"`

ops-bot: runtime flag override updated by ken at 2026-01-14T21:22:45Z (TTL 30m).

mira: release notes updated: "postdeploy: streaming chunk tail increase observed in us-west after continuous-batching kernel flip; in-region fallback to legacy batching applied. Investigating." Notified CS and platform-exec.

jason: we'll reconvene in 25m for unpin/unflag decision. If p95 remains <90ms and no error uptick, remove override and try a staged kernel re-roll with tighter assembly timeouts.

perf-bot: override TTL expiring in 2m.

ken: TTL extended; leaving monitoring 60m. Opened ticket: infra/continuous-kernel-investigation-311222. Adding perf diffs + traces.

mira: post-watch quickcheck (after 30m): streaming_chunk_p95=80ms, p99=120ms, errors 0.04%. Stable. Removing override later today after kernel patch or we schedule a canary of kernel with adjusted assembly heuristics. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
